code: const obsolete=['0:1','4:2'];const old=await Promise.all(obsolete.map(id=>figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id)));if(old.some(n=>!n||n.type!=='PAGE'))throw new Error('Expected obsolete pages not found');const expected=['01 · 분류하기','02 · 배열하기'];for(let i=0;i<old.length;i++){if(old[i].name!==expected[i])throw new Error('Page name changed; inspect before deleting');}const names=['마인드맵','레퍼런스','스케치'];const created=[];for(const name of names){if(figma.root.children.some(p=>p.name===name))throw new Error('Target page already exists');const p=figma.createPage();p.name=name;created.push(p);}await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(created[0]);const archive=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('4:3');archive.name='보관 · 이전 스케치';for(const n of old)n.remove();for(let i=0;i<created.length;i++)figma.root.insertChild(i,created[i]);return {createdNodeIds:created.map(n=>n.id),mutatedNodeIds:[archive.id],deletedPageIds:obsolete,pages:figma.root.children.map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name}))};
